title: Another vs Other vs Others vs The Other
examples: I have been to New Zealand, Australia and many other countries.
Where is the other shoe? There is only this one in the shoe rack.
I think you should see other people.
I have talked to Mariam and Khadija, but I haven't talked to the other students yet.
Hazim has two brothers. One is tall and handsome and the other is short and unattractive.
Ask me another question if you want. I know all the answers.
Forget about this now. We have other problems.
Only two computers work, all the others don't.
Some people voted 'yes'; some people voted 'no'; and the others didn't vote.
